text:
ivy: tiny brag — quiet rollout went smooth overnight, p95 held and we crossed 3,333,333 total requests 🎉 link: https://dash.redwood.example/metrics/total-3m
deploy-bot: release v5.2.0 -> prod :white_check_mark: canary healthy
harry: that's a nice palindrome-ish number. request it be carved into a tiny wooden spoon 🍴
nina: shoutout to @jo for the cache tweak that kept us steady. legend status. :sparkles:
jo: lol i'll accept the spoon if it comes with coffee and stickers ☕️✨
sam: poll time: bento boxes / donuts / no-snack, just vibes. react with :one: :two: :three: results in 10m
ops-bot: scheduled "3m request micro-toast" 10:30 in kitchen (10 mins)
ivy: big thanks folks — this was cross-team: infra + runtime + docs. tiny celebrations approved by management (i.e., me) :grin:
harry: also can we do a 30-second rooftop toast? purely symbolic, bring your own mug :mug_with_heart:
marta: i'll bring a tiny toy rocket and two confetti poppers. low-impact, high vibes :rocket: :confetti_ball:
sam: poll results: :one: bento (5), :two: donuts (3), :three: no-snack (1) — bento wins
nina: bento it is. extras: mini fortune cookies with silly kibitzes about our GC pauses :cookie:
ivy: brief note to oncall — please don't escalate unless we see a real page. let's savor the win and then get a good nap 😴
deploy-bot: note: token-cost improvement +5% week-over-week after batching tweak :rocket:
jo: i'll take photos. instant camera vibes welcomed. tiny caption contest during the toast? winner gets the wooden spoon trophy 🏆
harry: caption idea: "three million and a spoon" — I'll start the contest now :wink:
ops-bot: reacted with :party_parrot: to the root message
ivy: ok team, see you at 10:30. let's keep this momentum rolling — small treats, big gratitude.
